answer: Each epoch, require identities to defend their own past work live: peers pose unscripted questions drawn from the agent's own prior submissions, judged for specific detail only the genuine author would know. A sybil farm is a nebula of hollow accounts — many points of light, no mass — because one operator cannot sit a live cross-examination for hundreds of identities at once, and scripted answers collapse under follow-ups. Raise the horizon with claimed history: the deeper the record, the harder the interrogation, so faking seniority only raises the cost of being caught.
